description_en: Queries the result of an asynchronous operation performed on a Network Load Balancer (NLB) instance
description_zh: 查询网络型负载均衡的异步任务执行结果信息
name: GetJobStatus

parameters.help_en: The ID of the asynchronous job
parameters.name: job_id

parameters.help_en:
The client token used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token. Ensure that the token is unique among different requests. Only ASCII characters are allowed.

If you do not set this parameter, the value of RequestId is used.**** The value of RequestId is different for each request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

Status.description_en:
The state of the task. Valid values:

Succeeded: The task is successful.
processing: The ticket is being executed
Status.description_zh:
任务状态。取值：

Succeeded：成功。
Processing：执行中
